The font and icon set Omarchy's shell, terminal and editors are designed against.
omarchy-fonts installs the faces Omarchy's own configuration names: the
JetBrains Mono Nerd variant its terminal and Quickshell bar render with, the
iA Writer family its editor themes reference, Noto for CJK and emoji coverage,
and the Yaru icon theme and GTK theme engine its GTK applications resolve
against. Without them the desktop still starts but renders with fallback
faces and missing glyph boxes wherever a Nerd Font symbol is used, which is
most of the bar. Verifiable on the built image: each font package is
installed and fontconfig can resolve the families by name.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `check` | the Nerd-patched coding font the bar and prompt draw glyphs from is installed |
| `check` | fontconfig resolves the coding font family by name |
| `check` | emoji coverage resolves, so the bar and notifications render glyphs not boxes |
| `check` | the Yaru icon theme Omarchy's GTK applications resolve against is installed |
